scope: guest auto-scrape preference and capture behavior across warm state, full extension reload, and original-setting restoration in an owned native side panel

criteria.name: ON emits one real capture with the page marker
OFF emits no capture after the loaded page settles
On changes visible and stored preference
On extension worker and panel were replaced
ON survives full extension reload and emits one real capture
original preference restored before extension reload
Off extension worker and panel were replaced
OFF survives full extension reload with zero capture calls
original preference restored after extension reload
Original OFF baseline restored in UI and chrome.storage

observed: All 13 named T40 criteria passed, including ON capture, OFF zero-capture behavior, preference persistence across full extension reload, worker/panel replacement, and restoration of the original OFF baseline.
limits: Acceptance is limited to these 13 guest T40 criteria on the exact frozen development artifact.
This does not establish other Settings controls or the complete Settings feature.
This does not establish member/admin behavior, current-main product health, Chrome Web Store installation, or Store acceptance.
No raw preference values, capture payloads, page URLs, account/organization data, screenshots, or private runner paths are included.
